svg.title: MEGA-KVM rack elevation
svg.text: MEGA-KVM rack elevation (11 RU, 488.9 mm): front view and side view (front at the left), 1 unit = 1 mm
FAN PLATE 1 (4RU, on shelf 1, covers shelves 1-4)
FAN PLATE 2 (4RU, on shelf 5, covers shelves 5-8)
KVM: fans + display + inputs | GS105, power | Mimas+shield bays
DUT HDMI, JTAG, KBD, 12V leads, LAN
Shelves: 6 mm deck on 25 x 25 battens; MEGA65 board (green), floppy (dashed), Cart64out (blue), strain bar at the rear.
Fan plates (4RU, 3 x 120 mm fans, staggered) screw to the front ends of the bottom shelf of each group; gusset in brown.
Fan clearance mode: notch (decks notched 28 mm deep; non-carrier battens start 92 mm back).
